**(f) Unexpected high scenario:**
A major war, pandemic, or financial crisis requiring emergency spending; large stimulus packages; or significant expansion of entitlements. Combined with the reconciliation bill adding substantial tax cuts and spending, outlays could reach $9,000,000–$10,000,000 million.

The CBO baseline of ~$8,151,000 million is the most credible anchor. The timing shift effect adds a modest boost. DOGE savings are unlikely to dramatically alter the trajectory given mandatory spending dominance. The reconciliation bill likely adds to outlays net.
